notes.title: 🎉 Basureroes Now Supports More Languages! 🎉
notes.content:
🎉 Basureroes Now Supports More Languages! 🎉

Hey Trash Heroes! 🦸‍♂️🗑️

We’ve got some exciting news—Basureroes is now available in Korean 🇰🇷, Chinese Simplified 🇨🇳, Chinese Traditional 🇭🇰, and Japanese 🇯🇵!

We know many of you have been waiting for this, and we’re thrilled to bring our chaotic, trash-fighting adventure to even more players around the world. Now you can clean up the streets, battle pollution, and save the planet in your preferred language!

Thank you for your support, and as always, let us know if you run into any issues or have feedback.

🗑️ Keep fighting the good fight, heroes! 🌎✨

Here is the full changelog of issues fixed.
[list]
[*] Added full compatibility with Japanese, Traditional Chinese, Simplified Chinese, and Korean.
[*] Added the option to skip a few previously unskippable dialogs.
[*] Added an extra checkpoint in the castle to prevent a repeating dialog.
[*] Added a new petting feature: you can now pet rats and other animals—and if you insist, you might just earn their love!
[*] Improved the carrying mechanic: you can now attack while carrying dogs or other players!
[*] Improved particle optimization in some levels and how assets are loaded.
[*] Fixed two issues with dogs: they could disappear into a wall or get stuck if they stopped in a narrow passage.
[*] Fixed a missing wall in the harbour.
[*] Fixed two achievements.
[*] Fixed music loops, as some were not working properly.
[*] Fixed a minor issue with player depth in multiplayer.
[*] Other minor bug fixes and improvements.
[/list]
